94a-scale-of-life.png: Scale of life (Gate 11.1): 24 sizes from a water molecule (derived from its PubChem3D conformer) to an ant on one log axis, quoted from NIGMS Inside the Cell, NIGMS Biomedical Beat, nano.gov, the U.S. DOE Scale of Things chart and the PDB-101 virus flyer.
94b-egg-vs-red-cell.png: A red blood cell (~7–8 µm, DOE chart) compared with the human egg (150 µm, Inside the Cell p. 20): the egg is about 20 times wider (the range counts as its geometric mean).
94c-landing-biologic.png: The landing page with the live BIOLOGIC portal: the 486 atoms of the B-DNA dodecamer 1BNA (Drew et al. 1981, PDB CC0) coloured by element.
95a-amino-acids.png: The 20 amino acids (Gate 11.2): IUPAC-IUB one- and three-letter symbols, the bundled PubChem3D conformers, ChEBI descriptions and, for leucine, its six codons in NCBI’s standard code.
95b-genetic-code.png: NCBI’s Standard Code as a codon table (stops red, possible starts outlined) translating ATGGCCATTGTAATGGGCCGCTGA to MAIVMGR* in frame 1; amber marks the four codons read differently in vertebrate mitochondria.
